_doc: Fit-scoring config (D-005, PRD Appendix E). Weights are defaults; the app's Settings override them at read time. Pay bands compare the featured Canadian range (CAD, annual) to the user's target. Rubric text: docs/eng/SCORING_RUBRIC.md.

pay_target_cad._doc: Default for a Google L5 operating near L6, based on Toronto Senior/Staff PM bands (DR-1, DR-2). Score uses the top of the posted Canadian range; base-only ranges compared directly, bonus-inclusive ranges discounted 10%.
